question: When did the Yonex-Sunrise All India Senior Ranking Badminton Tournament 2025 take place in Moinabad, Telangana?
solution:
The correct answer is __**8-15 May 2025**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Yonex-Sunrise All India Senior Ranking Badminton Tournament 2025** is a premier domestic badminton event scheduled to be held from **8 May to 15 May 2025**.
 
• The tournament is hosted in **Moinabad**, located in the **Rangareddy district** of **Telangana**, India.
 
• The specific venue for the matches is the **Chetan Anand Badminton Academy (CABA)**, which is known for its world-class facilities and coaching for elite athletes.
 
• The event is officially sanctioned and conducted under the aegis of the **Badminton Association of India (BAI)**, the national governing body for the sport.
 
• The competition features five primary categories: **Men’s Singles**, **Women’s Singles**, **Men’s Doubles**, **Women’s Doubles**, and **Mixed Doubles**.
 
• The tournament serves as a critical platform for senior athletes to earn **ranking points** that determine their national standing and eligibility for international selections.
